prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too high overall, though several major winning changes (such as sign_in redesign in r6, choose_path redesign in r10, adoption new_flow in r12, adoption incentive in r13, choose_path copy in r14, finish redesign in r15, and adoption redesign in r16) were underpredicted.
Sign-in hint changes were helpful, winning 3 of 10 tests (rounds 1, 7, and 15), while the remaining 7 showed no clear effect or slight negative results.
Home wait_info changes were helpful, winning 2 of 10 tests (rounds 13 and 14), while the remaining 8 showed no clear effect.
Finish new_screen changes consistently failed to produce positive results, showing no clear effect or hurting performance across all 3 tests with zero wins.
Redesigns across adoption, finish, and sign-in categories frequently hurt performance or showed no clear effect, despite occasional isolated wins.
Evidence remains thin or outcomes are mixed for single-test categories and small categories with conflicting results (such as adoption new_flow, adoption incentive, choose_path copy/layout, and home notifications).

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Grid Preview Redesign: Redesign pick_friend screen with a grid layout featuring live animated companion choice cards for faster selection. (why: Adoption step drops significantly to 70.7% completion; a visual grid layout helps users pick pets faster.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Companion Personality Trait Flow: Add a companion personality selection screen during adoption where users choose pet behavior traits before issuing the certificate. (why: Adoption conversion is low at 70.7%, and post-onboarding support shows confusion around pet interactions.)
2: [finish, redesign] Desktop Pet Quick Controls Welcome Redesign: Redesign home_intro with a split layout explaining key shortcuts for hiding, summoning, and talking to your pet. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control or hide the pet, and finish step drops to 72.5%.)
3: [home, new_screen] Desktop Render Verification Screen: Insert a render verification screen after loading to ensure the desktop pet properly spawned before completing setup. (why: 3 support tickets reported the pet not appearing on desktop or app failing to display after setup.)
4: [choose_path, copy] Story Intro Companion Overview Copy: Update story screen headline and body text to clearly describe how desktop pets assist and interact daily. (why: The choose_path mean duration is 514s; clearer early narrative helps users choose their journey without long hesitation.)
5: [sign_in, hint] Account Pet Save Safeguard Hint: Add explicit hint text on the sign_in screen confirming that account login protects pet customization data. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing in again.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Engine Ready Companion Wait Info: Update waiting screen status headline and step progress explaining engine initialization details. (why: Home step median time is 201s (mean 2336s); detailed engine status reassures users during initialization.)
7: [home, notification] Desktop Pet Ready System Notification: Enable desktop notification toggle on waiting screen so users get alerted when pet render finishes. (why: Users wait a median of 201s on home; system notifications bring back tabbed-out or idle users.)
8: [finish, layout] Compact Layout Desktop Welcome Overview: Switch home_intro layout to compact mode with interactive checklist for pet controls. (why: Finish step conversion is 72.5%; concise compact layouts reduce cognitive load before entering main desktop app.)
